messages:
Alex Chen: Created RC v2026.03.17-rc3 with pinned artifact sha: `7f2a9b2`. Ready for promo if infra checks pass.
Priya Nair: quick note — this RC includes the users table split migration (deferred rollout). we need the migration window approved before full traffic.
Jun Park: which migration exactly? paste the migration diff?
Alex Chen: Jun — it's the add shard_key migration for users. script: `ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN shard_key varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL;` followed by backfill job. staged backfill only on canary.
deploybot: Deployment candidate created: job=deploy-1732124321 artifact=7f2a9b2 target=canary. Preflight checks queued.
deploybot: Preflight result: FAILED — kv-warm check flaky in us-west-2 (timeout on warmup). See logs: https://ci.redwood/ci/1732124321/preflight
Sarah O'Neill: @alex @jun hmm — kv-warm flakiness is the same as yesterday. Ops suggests hold promo until a second warm attempt passes or we route canary to us-east only.
Mike Torres: Product prefers not to delay release unless user-facing risk. What's the risk if canary is east-only?
Priya Nair: east-only keeps existing latency SLA for majority but might miss perf edge-cases. migration backfill will still run on canary in east. we should pin version and do staggered rollout by region.
Alex Chen: I propose: 1) pin RC 7f2a9b2 2) promote to canary in us-east only 3) run backfill on canary (low qps) 4) re-run kv-warm in us-west during quietwindow 5) if kv-warm passes, expand to us-west and then 100% traffic.
Jun Park: +1. Add rollback criteria: if backfill error rate >0.5% or error budget burn > 5% in canary, abort and rollback to previous artifact `3c1f0a9`. Also if kv-warm fails second attempt, revert promo.
Sarah O'Neill: I'll be on-call sheriff for the promo window and will monitor traces. assign runbook: `runbook://rc-promo-db-backfill` and I'll trigger rollback if alarms fire.
deploybot: Promotion started: stage=canary region=us-east job=deploy-1732124321 step=promote -> in_progress
Alex Chen: Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/releases/2026-03-17-rc3.md — includes migration notes and feature-flag `users.sharded` controlled rollout. Please review quick.
Mike Torres: Reviewed; added P0 user impact note and rollback instructions. Good to go if ops + infra agree.
Priya Nair: small ask — add a header to release notes that the DB schema is backwards compatible for reads, writes will be feature-gated. avoids confusion.
Alex Chen: done. thanks.
deploybot: Promote step complete (canary/us-east) — status=success. backfill job queued: job=backfill-1732124350 shards=4 mode=throttle
Jun Park: backfill started. monitoring key metrics: `users.backfill.progress`, `users.write-latency`, `api.500_rate`
Sarah O'Neill: saw a spike in write latency for 2 min at start of backfill, stabilized after throttle step. currently metrics within thresholds.
deploybot: kv-warm retry scheduled for us-west at 1732124600.
Alex Chen: scheduling us-west warm and small canary there only if warm passes. keeping pin in place.
deploybot: kv-warm (us-west) result: SUCCESS after retry. logs: https://ci.redwood/ci/1732124321/warm-2
Alex Chen: Excellent. planning to expand to us-west canary + increase traffic to 20% in 10m, full in 60m if no regression. rollback if `api.5xx` > 0.3% sustained for 5m.
Mike Torres: thumbs up from product.
Priya Nair: tagging release notes link in customer-facing changelog draft.
Sarah O'Neill: keeping watch. will post `:warning:` if anything smells off.
deploybot: Rolling out to us-west canary -> in_progress.
deploybot: us-west canary promote complete. traffic ramp to 20% scheduled.
Jun Park: metrics look stable at 20% for 12 minutes. no errors. ramping to 50% now.
Alex Chen: ramp to 100% scheduled in 30m barring alerts.
Sarah O'Neill: all good on my side. I'll stay available for the next hour.
Mike Torres: updating release thread and notes. congrats team. :tada:
Alex Chen: Promo complete. RC v2026.03.17-rc3 -> production. pinned artifact 7f2a9b2 documented. Closing thread after quietwindow.
